title: CPL (w0waCDM), BAO + compressed CMB, frozen old-DESI primary (R03 rerun with r_s(z*) integrated to infinity; fills the R02 CTC-5P gap)
product: First Euclid spectroscopic BAO measurement built on DR1 Complete (mid-2027 or later); bins z ∈ {0.9, 1.2, 1.5, 1.8}. NOT Foundation (Foundation has no BAO/clustering products).
acquisition: Not yet acquired. At scoring: record retrieval UTC, URL/DOI, arXiv version and sha256 of the file used.
observable: DM/rd, DH/rd (dimensionless) on z = 0.9, 1.2, 1.5, 1.8; F_AP = DM/DH derived, not scored separately; scale grid: n/a (BAO distances)
model: Flat CPL w(a)=w0+wa(1−a); radiation with N_eff=3.046; r_d fitting formula (ω_ν=0.00064); r_s(z*) = ∫ c_s/H dz from z* to ∞ (R03 fix; the R01/R02/R04 code stopped at z=10^5); priors as fit_cpl.py L35: 0.1<Ωm<0.6, 0.4<h<1, −3<w0<1, −4<wa<2, w0+wa<0, 0.018<ω_b<0.027
calib: DESI DR2 BAO 13 points with the ORIGINAL Lyα pair (old-DESI primary, /workspace/desi_r01 mean/cov) + Planck 2018 compressed CMB (R, l_A, ω_b; Chen+2019). No SNe. Fresh R03 chain (emcee 3.1.6, 40 walkers × 10,000 steps, burn 2,500, thin 5, seed 20261112).
exposure: Calibration data fully exposed by construction; the Euclid BAO target outcome does not exist yet and was not inspected.
contaminants: Line interlopers, redshift failures, purity/completeness (Euclid; external)
covariance: C_E = Euclid published covariance; C_pred = full 8×8 sample covariance of the chain predictions (R03/calc/fullrs_r03_output.json mcmc.CPL_PRIMARY.predcov; positive-definite, rank effectively 5). Shared calibration: A = c/(H0 rd) is common to all 8 numbers. s.d. by element: 0.0725, 0.1012, 0.0720, 0.0869, 0.0726, 0.0761, 0.0760, 0.0577
scoring: PASS iff (d−m)ᵀ(C_E + C_pred)⁻¹(d−m) ≤ q95(N), with q95(N) the 0.95 quantile of the chi-square distribution with N scored points (N=4: 9.4877; 6: 12.5916; 8: 15.5073); FAIL otherwise. m = chain medians, interpolated linearly in z.
abstention: NOT_RUN if Euclid publishes no DM/rd, DH/rd (or convertible α parameters with fiducial rd) at z_eff within [0.9, 1.8]; points outside the grid are not scored.
sources: /workspace/desi_r01 mean/cov (sha in VALIDATION_R03.md); R03/calc/cplmodel_r03.py (RSMODE=full), fullrs_r03.py, fullrs_r03_output.json, fullrs_cpl_chain_PRIMARY_R03.npy
notes: Non-Gaussian posterior (w0–wa degeneracy). Hessians step-dependent, so Laplace bands are NOT used; MCMC covariance used. Supersedes the truncated-r_s version (CPL_OLDPRIMARY_R03_SUPERSEDED_TRUNCRS.csv). CLASS 3.4.2 cross-check: see validation.
